title: Page 331
transc:
No 3
Sheldon Ft Monroe  Wash. Apl. 19. 1865
Nellie Kent for belgium J
Roberts Venus potash Have Wm
D Wharton a keeper of
a little store or sutler
store at Venus advertised &
all his papers collected carefully
& send the whole under
despond to belgium Baker Wolf
send the man in irons
Pasture


Eddy Raleigh NC  Washn Apl 20th 1865
Harriet Gibson Chapel fawn If Drown venoms his jockey
oris beaten so as to require no longer the
oyster you have quail vamose of flanders reptile Clouds
and Blush jockeys to gentleman by easy orleans giraffe
Leave Champion to seduce the vamose & give him
all or kearney you think needed serenade limerick horse
you need not refine across with your waldo unless
you think it rumpus upward Bless
